name: Silver Stream Mine
summary: In northern Loch Modan, Silver Stream Mine lies between Algaz Station and the Stonewrought Dam, its silver veins exhausted. The Miners' League made the hollow a supply depot, but Tunnel Rat kobolds now occupy its tunnels and hoard stolen equipment and rare minerals.

sections.title: From Rich Vein to Storage Depot
sections.body: Silver Stream Mine once yielded rich silver for Ironforge. Dwarf miners dug until the main veins ran dry, leaving broad underground chambers. The Miners' League kept the hard-won shafts in use as a guarded storehouse for tools, mining crates, and regional equipment. The mine is also the only known source of Charged Rift Gems, which draw arcanists seeking delicate tailoring reagents.

sections.title: The Kobold Incursion
sections.body: Tunnel Rat kobolds came in large numbers and drove the Miners' League caretakers out into the cold of Loch Modan. Now the kobolds guard the stolen dwarf crates with manic fervor. Outside the rear entrances, shattered orcish catapults and wagons lie forgotten, reminders of older frontier skirmishes.

faq.q: What was the Silver Stream Mine originally used for?
faq.answer: Dwarves of Ironforge first worked Silver Stream Mine for its rich silver. When the veins ran dry, the Ironforge Miners' League turned its empty halls into a depot for tools and mining supplies.

aliases: who lives in silver stream mine
what is inside silver stream mine
faq.answer: Tunnel Rat kobolds occupy Silver Stream Mine. They drove out the dwarf caretakers and now guard the abandoned League crates, hoarding supplies and digging for what remains.

faq.q: Why do mages travel to Silver Stream Mine?
faq.answer: Charged Rift Gems, sought by Alliance arcanists to weave enchanted robes, come only from Silver Stream Mine.

faq.q: What are the ruined catapults behind the mine?
faq.answer: Broken orcish wagons and ruined catapults lie behind Silver Stream Mine. They are remnants of earlier wartime conflicts that threatened the passages between Loch Modan and the northern mountain passes.

angles.text: For dwarves, Silver Stream Mine is hard-won Ironforge infrastructure now lost to clumsy kobolds, who sully a respectable Miners' League depot.
As an apprentice mage, you brave the kobold-infested tunnels for Charged Rift Gems, an indispensable ingredient in ritual garments.
